ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: Digital Editing Techniques For Music Educators This two-week course is designed as an introductory class to offer music educators information and hands-on experience with Pro Tools digital audio recording/editing software for improving the quality of recordings of your ensembles, as well as master recording preparation and rehearsal disc preparation using a variety of hardware and software for your classroom and ensemble needs. Appropriate digital transfer to CD-R will also be addressed. All course participants will be assigned daily lab times and will work directly with the equipment and programs. FIRST TWO WEEKS ONLY - JUNE 16 THROUGH JUNE 26 This course may be considered as a either a music or music education elective.
